cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Terms and Conditions
cards.instruction: Treat every offer, favor, feeling, and apology as a negotiation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I'll accept your apology for missing my birthday if I get first choice of Christmas dates.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mum already expects me Christmas Day.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Boxing Day, then. In exchange, I'll tell her I'm no longer hurt.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'd rather you actually stopped being hurt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay through New Year and I'll mean it. I'll even stop mentioning the birthday to Mum.

mechanism: A uses lessons in making amends to bargain over both public forgiveness and its actual feeling.
confusable: Unlike only requesting an apology, A prices emotional sincerity and holiday time as exchangeable terms.
comparison: Practical loan terms versus family apology and competing holiday commitments.
seedUse: Keep D22 birthday/Christmas/Boxing Day/New Year escalation; S05 grading effort gives A justification for revised terms.
